messages:
Alex Chen: quick sanity-check thread for the cross-family GPTQ bake we just ran — sharing the TL;DR and ops notes
Mira Patel: thanks — can you paste the short eval table?
Alex Chen: bench-bot posted the summary but reposting key rows here: Llama-2-13B (FP32 baseline) MMLU=62.3, GPTQ-4bit=-1.4 pts, AWQ-8bit=-0.9 pts; Mistral-7B baseline MMLU=56.1, GPTQ-4bit=-2.1, FP8 prototype= -0.5; Qwen-7B baseline MMLU=58.9, GPTQ-4bit=-0.7 but observed KV degradation at >4k context
Samir Gupta: KV degradation for Qwen — is that perf (latency) or accuracy?
Alex Chen: accuracy / context retention — scored with long-context QA probe; recall drops ~3% after 8k on GPTQ variants compared to FP32
Priya Lopez: interesting that Mistral FP8 is close to baseline. did we use per-channel scale or symmetric quant?
Alex Chen: FP8 experiment used adaptive exponent per-layer (hf/experimental fp8-adapt), per-channel for weights where available. AWQ used symmetric per-channel with second-order rounds
Mira Patel: what's the latency/cost tradeoff on our p4d cluster? numbers pls
bench-bot: latency summary (avg token time) — p4d: FP32=12ms, GPTQ-4bit=6.5ms, AWQ-8bit=7.1ms; a100-sxm: FP32=9.8ms, GPTQ=5.4ms; T4-ish (<8GB): GPTQ memory reduced by ~45% vs FP32, token times ~+10% vs A100
Samir Gupta: nice. Are we seeing any hallucination regression on instruction tasks?
Alex Chen: run small instruction eval set (125 prompts): Llama-2 GPTQ had increased refusal rate by 2.3% and a small rouge-l drop on summarization (~0.4). Mistral FP8 had negligible change in refusals
Priya Lopez: deployment notes — which model variants are safe for hosted API canary?
Alex Chen: suggested rollout for now: Llama-2-13B-gptq-4bit -> canary 5% traffic for 24h with QA hooks, fallback to FP32 variant on regressions. Mistral-7B-fp8-proto -> internal-only canary (no external customers) until we validate more datasets. Qwen-7B-gptq-4bit -> hold on long-context flows; allow for <=4k contexts only
Mira Patel: any config overrides for batching/kv cache?
Alex Chen: yes — for GPTQ we enabled `kv_cache_strict=true` and prefetched KV on first token to avoid cold-start spikes. Suggest batch_size=4 for low-latency routes, batch_size=16 for throughput jobs; autoscaler target 75% utilization
Samir Gupta: did the bake include mixed-precision fallback tests? i.e., GPTQ runtime fallback to FP16 for certain layers when divergence detected
Alex Chen: we tested hybrid execution: fallback on attention layers if mismatch > threshold. It reduced regressions but added ~8% latency on the fallback path. Good safety knob
Priya Lopez: can you paste the eval command you used so infra can repro?
Alex Chen: sure
Priya Lopez: ```
python eval/run_eval.py --models "llama-2-13b, mistral-7b, qwen-7b" --quant-methods "gptq4,awq8,fp8-proto" --suites "mmlu,long-context-qa,instruct-125" --save results/2623456789.json
```
Mira Patel: noted. Any surprising regressions besides Qwen long-context?
Alex Chen: small: Llama-2 GPTQ occasionally regresses on math-word problems (GSM8K subset) by ~1.7 pts — probably rounding-sensitive ops in a few MLP layers. We flagged 3 checkpoints for targeted retrain/quant-fine-tune
Samir Gupta: ops followups? files to upload to the model hub?
Alex Chen: uploaded artifacts: `gptq-4bit-checkpoint.tar.gz`, `awq-8b-profile.json`, `fp8-mistral-profiles/` to s3://redwood-bakes/2623456789. Added checksums in the bake ticket
Priya Lopez: rollout plan + ticket?
Alex Chen: created ticket ML-OPS-4217 with canary playbook, rollback steps, and eval endpoints. Assigning Samir for canary monitoring, Mira for eval dashboard, Priya for customer messaging
Samir Gupta: I can monitor — will wire up alert if MMLU delta > 1.0 or long-context recall drop >2.5%
Mira Patel: I'll add charts to the model dashboard and link the raw eval JSONs
Priya Lopez: I'll draft a short customer note about the Llama/GPTQ option availability and the Qwen context caveat
Alex Chen: thanks all — next steps: retrain/quant-finetune the 3 Llama checkpoints, run extended Mistral FP8 sweeps on more datasets, and re-test Qwen with a KV-stability patch (PR#1092). Closing thread for now :white_check_mark:
bench-bot: artifact summary uploaded: results/2623456789.json, profiles/2623456789/*
